matchup_context: against heroes with high regen like Huskar
insight: Withering Mist reduces enemy health restoration by 35% when they drop below 40% HP, tilting specific matchups and providing general utility in fights.

source.title: The Most Overlooked Part of Heroes (Tierlist)

insight: Greed is hero-defining. Without this innate, Alchemist would not function as intended. The gold generation is core to the hero's identity and gameplay.

source.title: The Most Overlooked Part of Heroes (Tierlist)

insight: Attack slow scales with enemy mana deficit up to max at 0 mana. Most effective when enemies are low on mana and benefits from mana burn or enemies without active mana items.

source.title: The Most Overlooked Part of Heroes (Tierlist)

insight: Gains regen rune buff for 4 seconds when activating any rune. Provides value even from water runes and bounty runes picked up from the map.

source.title: The Most Overlooked Part of Heroes (Tierlist)

insight: Gains permanent armor stacks on hero kills. Encourages aggressive play but doesn't change core gameplay since you try to secure kills anyway.

source.title: The Most Overlooked Part of Heroes (Tierlist)

insight: Attack debuff deals 20% of attack damage per second for 2 seconds. Particularly strong in lane and works with Arsonist sticky napalm for core Batrider builds.

source.title: The Most Overlooked Part of Heroes (Tierlist)

insight: Melee damage block chance increased from 50% to 100% versus non-hero units. Significantly improves laning and jungling by taking minimal damage from creeps.

source.title: The Most Overlooked Part of Heroes (Tierlist)

insight: Restores 30 HP plus percentage of unit max health on kills. Core to laning sustain and enables aggressive fighting to sustain through burst healing on kills.

source.title: The Most Overlooked Part of Heroes (Tierlist)

insight: 20% extra gold on killing kill-streaked heroes. Underwhelming because Bounty Hunter's playstyle focuses on hunting anyone, not specifically high-streak targets.

source.title: The Most Overlooked Part of Heroes (Tierlist)

insight: Below 50% HP grants status resistance and alternating movement speed buff that strengthens at lower health. Can be lifesaving but impact is difficult to gauge.

source.title: The Most Overlooked Part of Heroes (Tierlist)

insight: 10% damage and debuff duration amplification against heroes behind you. Synergizes with natural playstyle but doesn't change how you approach fights.

source.title: The Most Overlooked Part of Heroes (Tierlist)

insight: Killing units heals her and controlled units within 600 radius (40% reduced from creeps). Provides sustain to stay on map longer during farming.

source.title: The Most Overlooked Part of Heroes (Tierlist)

insight: Permanently gains HP on level up. Not hero-defining but provides consistent survivability scaling throughout the game.

source.title: The Most Overlooked Part of Heroes (Tierlist)

insight: 50% chance for extra illusion to spawn when creating illusions. Can be game-changing with level 1 ultimate but reliability is inconsistent.

source.title: The Most Overlooked Part of Heroes (Tierlist)

insight: Can choose facet at game start and summon corresponding creep. Hero-defining mechanic requiring optimization for laning impact and game plan.

source.title: The Most Overlooked Part of Heroes (Tierlist)

insight: Outgoing damage increases 0.25% per armor point with Chainmail facet. Underwhelming because Clockwerk isn't a primary damage dealer despite the broken scaling.

source.title: The Most Overlooked Part of Heroes (Tierlist)

insight: 25-100% mana regen amplification. Solid innate that supports her core role but doesn't require specialized build adjustments.

source.title: The Most Overlooked Part of Heroes (Tierlist)

insight: Restores percentage of max health and mana on level up. Critical to laning phase survival and allows different lane playstyle than without it.

source.title: The Most Overlooked Part of Heroes (Tierlist)

insight: Abilities apply weave to allies and enemies, increasing and decreasing armor respectively. Useful passive that synergizes with kit but doesn't change playstyle.

source.title: The Most Overlooked Part of Heroes (Tierlist)

insight: Movement speed and cooldown reduction per level up. Strong innate providing insane scaling but hero viability depends on meta.

source.title: The Most Overlooked Part of Heroes (Tierlist)

insight: Takes over 250 damage in 400 radius pushes nearby enemies back up to 400 units. Situationally powerful but often only delays death by seconds.

source.title: The Most Overlooked Part of Heroes (Tierlist)

insight: Attacks deal 25% bonus damage to heroes lower level than Doom. Was stronger when carry Doom was meta; now situational.

source.title: The Most Overlooked Part of Heroes (Tierlist)

insight: Life blood provides armor and health regen scaling with levels. Hero-defining innate making the hero significantly weaker without it.

source.title: The Most Overlooked Part of Heroes (Tierlist)

insight: Gains agility scaling and nearby ranged heroes receive 50% of bonus. S-tier innate as hero is literally built around double-dipping on agility.

source.title: The Most Overlooked Part of Heroes (Tierlist)

insight: Enemies hit by spells fly through air based on distance. Highly visible but A-tier rather than S-tier as hero functions without knowing about it.

source.title: The Most Overlooked Part of Heroes (Tierlist)

insight: Allied creeps and buildings hit by glyph gain 100% bonus damage. Extremely niche; most players don't know about this innate.

source.title: The Most Overlooked Part of Heroes (Tierlist)

insight: Continuously burns dealing damage to nearby enemies. Significantly improves farming and early laning phase with passive damage output.

source.title: The Most Overlooked Part of Heroes (Tierlist)

insight: Neutral camps and creeps under control deal more damage to enemies. Makes controlled creeps threatening; difficult for opponents to account for.

source.title: The Most Overlooked Part of Heroes (Tierlist)

insight: Allies within 500 range gain up to 15% damage reduction based on distance (max at 200 range). Situational, positioning-dependent.

source.title: The Most Overlooked Part of Heroes (Tierlist)

insight: Attack projectiles are slowed. Unclear purpose and impact; situational at best.

source.title: The Most Overlooked Part of Heroes (Tierlist)

insight: Attacks cause enemy heroes to leave ink trail. Strong for lane harassment, allows hitting enemies through trees, but limited utility beyond laning.

source.title: The Most Overlooked Part of Heroes (Tierlist)

insight: Can disassemble most items. A-tier because enables unique item combos and building paths like Falcon Blade into Crystalys.

source.title: The Most Overlooked Part of Heroes (Tierlist)

insight: Chance to redirect enemy attacks to nearby tree. Functions as evasion but requires trees nearby and adjustment to playstyle.

source.title: The Most Overlooked Part of Heroes (Tierlist)

insight: No mana; item mana costs convert to health costs. Hero-defining as it changes matchups and allows building items like Lotus Orb and Glimmer Cape.

source.title: The Most Overlooked Part of Heroes (Tierlist)

insight: Invoke ability creates and upgrades spells. Hero-defining; Invoker would be significantly weaker without this core innate.

source.title: The Most Overlooked Part of Heroes (Tierlist)

insight: Regenerates from consumables and items faster. Makes Io better at what it already does but doesn't change core playstyle.

source.title: The Most Overlooked Part of Heroes (Tierlist)

insight: Duelist innate grants bonus damage to enemies he faces. Works on towers and always applies during Omnislash for significant damage boost.

source.title: The Most Overlooked Part of Heroes (Tierlist)

insight: Cannot go below 75 mana. Underwhelming as only application is ensuring TP availability after mana burn; hero regenerates mana quickly anyway.

source.title: The Most Overlooked Part of Heroes (Tierlist)

insight: Switch and Discipline are literally the hero. S-tier because Kez is defined by these mechanics.

source.title: The Most Overlooked Part of Heroes (Tierlist)

insight: Takes damage over threshold triggers Admiral's Rum with movement speed and damage delay. Solid B-tier utility for survivability.

source.title: The Most Overlooked Part of Heroes (Tierlist)

insight: Buffs applied to team have extended duration. A-tier because it changes item builds and makes all buffs significantly more valuable.

source.title: The Most Overlooked Part of Heroes (Tierlist)

insight: Attack equal or higher level heroes for health restoration. Underwhelming as Duel is about manfighting regardless of enemy levels; innate doesn't help if losing fights.

source.title: The Most Overlooked Part of Heroes (Tierlist)

insight: Gains AoE per intelligence point. Very strong and worth building around; approaches hero-defining as hero is far weaker without it.

source.title: The Most Overlooked Part of Heroes (Tierlist)

insight: Cannot gain passive mana regen; only from enemy units dying. Hero-defining as players unfamiliar with this will play poorly, not understanding mana limitations.

source.title: The Most Overlooked Part of Heroes (Tierlist)

insight: Attacks deal damage and heal for percentage of target max health. S-tier hero-defining innate providing core sustain; hero lacks viability without it.

source.title: The Most Overlooked Part of Heroes (Tierlist)

insight: Damage to heroes triggers overheat on nearby enemies. D-tier as it's situational and rarely affects fight outcomes; overheat damage is rarely lethal.

source.title: The Most Overlooked Part of Heroes (Tierlist)

insight: Mana drain innate is fun and situational. C-tier because impact is inconsistent and requires specific situations to maximize.

source.title: The Most Overlooked Part of Heroes (Tierlist)

insight: Innate is literally what makes Lone Druid Lone Druid after recent rework. Hero-defining.

source.title: The Most Overlooked Part of Heroes (Tierlist)
